name: memory-recall
description: L1/L2/L3 cascade memory recall plugin for OpenClaw with per-agent LanceDB storage, Weibull decay, and progressive compaction. Pure TypeScript.

scripts.test: node --test tests/all.test.mjs && node --test tests/per-agent-isolation.test.mjs && node --test tests/worker-concurrency.test.mjs && node --test tests/bm25-negative-score.test.mjs && node --test tests/worker-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.test:worker: node --test tests/worker-smoke.test.mjs && node --test tests/per-agent-isolation.test.mjs && node --test tests/worker-concurrency.test.mjs
scripts.build: tsc src/cli.ts --outDir dist --esModuleInterop --module es2022 --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && tsc src/index.ts --outDir dist --esModuleInterop --module es2022 --target es2022 --skipLibCheck

changes: LanceDB field name fix (memory_id instead of id)
makeArrowTable for proper Arrow typed data
Table creation with dummy row to infer schema
Changed LLM model from qwen2.5:7b to qwen3.5:4b
message_received works for all channels (feishu, telegram, dashboard, tui)
Recall cache mechanism with TTL injection via before_prompt_build
Direct fetch to Ollama API for embedding + LLM extraction
